records.title: Recruitment Regulations of Staff and Officers of ESIC
details: The Honorable Minister inter-alia said that where there is no facility of ESIC hospitals, but where we have IPs, we empanel hospitals to provide complete treatment. I will also provide a complete list of those empanelled hospitals to the Honorable Member.

records.title: IMPROVING WATER RESOURCES IN THE STATE OF TELANGANA
PENDING PROJECTS OF TELANGANA
details: Total two proposals of Telangana are under different stages of consideration at the central level for grant of the Environmental clearance as per the provision of the Environment Impact Assessment (EIA) Notification, 2006, as amended.
